title: The Vacant Star
text: A star hangs low over the path, close enough to touch, pale and cold, dark at its center like an eye. It is looking at the party. It does not blink. Your shadows lean away from it.

options.label: The sharpest eye looks back at the star.

outcomes.text: It shows them how far the dark goes, and how little it cares. They come back knowing more than anyone should.
It shows them how far the dark goes, and they cannot stop looking.

options.label: Cover every face and walk on.

outcomes.text: It watches you go, and something like interest passes over it. That is worse.
